## ResourceAbsenceEvidenceSchema variable

The evidence behind a resource's `unsupported` marker, in one of two forms: the app's dictionary has no collection for it ([DictionaryAbsenceEvidenceSchema](./core.dictionaryabsenceevidenceschema.md)<!-- -->), or the running app fails every read of it ([LiveAbsenceEvidenceSchema](./core.liveabsenceevidenceschema.md)<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
ResourceAbsenceEvidenceSchema: z.ZodDiscriminatedUnion<
  [
    z.ZodObject<
      {
        source: z.ZodLiteral<'dictionary'>
        bundleId: z.ZodString
        appVersion: z.ZodString
        osVersion: z.ZodString
        term: z.ZodString
        finding: z.ZodEnum<{
          'no-class': 'no-class'
          'not-an-element': 'not-an-element'
        }>
      },
      z.core.$strict
    >,
    z.ZodObject<
      {
        source: z.ZodLiteral<'live'>
        observedAt: z.ZodISODateTime
        bundleId: z.ZodString
        appVersion: z.ZodString
        osVersion: z.ZodString
        expression: z.ZodString
        errorNumber: z.ZodNumber
      },
      z.core.$strict
    >,
  ],
  'source'
>
```
